_about: The feature request board's starting list (owner 2026-10-22: pre-populate it). Used ONCE, on a shard with no ~/ace/reports/features/board.json; after that the board file is the list. Each item: title (4-60 chars), text (up to 200), status open|planned|done|declined, votes = how many players asked for it before the board existed, source = where it came from. Edit freely; no em dashes. Order breaks vote ties.

items.title: Quick-bar numbers on inventory icons
items.text: An item that sits on the quick bar shows its slot number on its icon in your packs, so you can tell it apart from its twins.

items.title: Show which attributes raise each skill
items.text: Hovering a skill shows the attributes behind it, so you know which attributes to raise to lift that skill.

items.title: Option to hide the active spell icons
items.text: A way to hide the row of icons for your active buffs, which takes up screen space.

items.title: A radar for rare items
items.text: Something like the old Sixth Sense or Virindi radar that points out rare items and creatures nearby while you explore.

items.title: Founder's Shirt with full coverage
items.text: Make the Founder's Shirt cover the full torso and arms so it can be tailored onto full coverage shirts.

items.title: Freer movement while casting
items.text: Start a cast while strafing, and cancel a cast by moving or jumping. Declined: casting keeps the original game's rules, where a run or jump waits for the spell to finish.

items.title: Allegiance rank before player names
items.text: Show a player's allegiance rank title in front of their name.

items.title: Rearrange packs on the pack bar
items.text: Drag your side packs to put them in the order you want.

items.title: Mercenaries fade in after a portal
items.text: A hired mercenary that follows you through a portal fades in instead of popping into place.

items.title: Search in the spellbook
items.text: A search box on the spellbook page to find a spell by name.

items.title: Assistant casts vulnerabilities
items.text: The Assistant's spell tab can cast vulnerabilities on your target and lets you pick the spells it attacks with.

items.title: Ground cover off by default in the browser
items.text: Grass and flowers start off in the browser game, which runs much better on older cards. You can still turn them on.

items.title: Player Killer Lite for practice duels
items.text: A Player Killer Lite mode so friends can duel without a vitae penalty. Declined: Hollowtide keeps Darktide's player killer rules.
